note: Staged 2026-08-22 from the Landelijk Register Monumentale Bomen (Bomenstichting, attribution required). Publicly visitable single trees only, entries the register's own history says are gone already removed. Needs only a story per tree; see data/research/haarlemmermeer-verified.json for the write-pass input.

leads.name: Horse Chestnut, Nieuw-Vennep
leads.why: LRMB register nr 1688940 ('Witte paardenkastanje'). Register planting band 1910-1920, so the age is a BAND and must not be sharpened. Register records it as publicly visitable; owner category gemeente, setting agrarisch. Register history of the PLACE, not of the tree, so do not bridge from it: onbekend The register is ONE source. A second is wanted; without one the tree still ships with curation_status flagged.
